* First test version: your Uber Eats order on Smartspacer, with its status, the restaurant or courier, the time left or progress, and the courier's photo
* Works with the Uber Eats app and with food ordered in the Uber app
* Settings with a live preview of the card, in English and Spanish
* Alpha: not tested with a real order yet. If the card doesn't appear while your order is on its way, please open an issue
